pagetitle: "Zindel Lab — ETH Zürich"
description: "The Zindel Lab at ETH Zürich studies tissue repair, fibrosis, and foreign-body responses through intravital imaging in living mice."

::: {.lab-hero}
![Zindel Lab](assets/logo.webp){.lab-hero-logo}

[ETH Zürich · Institute of Molecular Health Sciences · D-BIOL]{.hero-place}

At the Zindel Lab, our mission is to improve patient outcomes after surgery by advancing the understanding of tissue repair, regeneration, and foreign body biology. Through innovative and rigorous biomedical research, we aim to uncover the cellular and molecular mechanisms that drive healing processes and identify novel strategies to enhance recovery, prevent complications, and improve implant function.

Beyond advancing science, we are committed to creating value for society — particularly in Switzerland — by translating discoveries into innovations, collaborating with industry partners, fostering entrepreneurial opportunities, and educating the next generation of scientists and clinicians who will shape the future of regenerative medicine and surgical care.
:::
